summary: 2U 64-port 800 GbE OSFP112 open networking switch for AI and data-center fabrics, with Enterprise SONiC.

value: ONIE for alternate network operating systems

value.ports: 64 x 800 GbE OSFP112 and 2 x 10 GbE SFP+
value.breakout: Up to 128 x 400 GbE, 256 x 200 GbE, or 320 x 100 GbE. The sheet marks some breakout modes provisional at RTS.
value.capacity: 102.4 Tbps full duplex, 51.2 Tbps non-blocking half duplex
value.aiFeaturesNote: The sheet lists versatile hashing, adaptive routing, cognitive routing, enhanced PFC queue configuration, AI observability, and SmartFabric Manager with asterisks. Those items were not treated as unqualified shipping features.

value.psus: Redundant hot-swappable AC or DC power supplies. The installation guide says PSUs are ordered separately.
value.note: Typical 1500 W is not the planning default. Low-line AC availability is 1500 W, which is below the published maximum utilized figure.

processors.note: Switch CPU details were not in the extracted specification sheet.

memory.note: Switch memory was not in the extracted specification sheet.

storage.note: On-switch storage was not in the extracted specification sheet.

firmwareBaseline.reason: No Enterprise SONiC version is included.
